camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribeProtoLogFieldStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --MaxResults 10 --LogField src_ip --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Groups protocol logs by a specified field and counts the number of log entries for each field value. Returns the specified number of groups. You can call ListProtoLogSupportIndex to select fields whose SupportGroupBy is set to true
description_zh: 按指定字段对协议日志分组并统计各字段值出现的日志条数，返回指定数量的分组。可先通过 ListProtoLogSupportIndex 选择 SupportGroupBy 为 true 的字段
name: DescribeProtoLogFieldStatistics

parameters.help_en: The log filter conditions in a JSON string. logicOp specifies the logical operator and can be set to and or or. logFilterItems specifies an array of conditions. Each condition includes logField, op, and value, where value is a string. logFilters can contain nested condition groups of the same structure. If this parameter is not specified, no field-level filtering is applied. You can call ListProtoLogSupportIndex to obtain the available fields and operators
parameters.help_zh: 日志过滤条件，使用 JSON 字符串。logicOp 为 and 或 or；logFilterItems 为条件数组，每项包含 logField、op、value，value 使用字符串；logFilters 可嵌套同结构的条件组。不传时不附加字段过滤。可用字段和运算符通过 ListProtoLogSupportIndex 获取
parameters.name: log_filter

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the query time range. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the time 30 minutes before the current time is used. The value must not be later than the value of ToTime. Specify both the start time and end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。不传或传 0 时，使用当前时间前 30 分钟；须不晚于 ToTime。建议同时传入开始和结束时间
parameters.name: from_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the query time range. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the current time is used. The value must not be earlier than the value of FromTime. If FromTime is equal to ToTime, the system queries logs within the 1-second time range from 1 second before ToTime to ToTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。不传或传 0 时，使用当前时间；须不早于 FromTime。当 FromTime 与 ToTime 相等时，系统按 ToTime 前 1 秒至 ToTime 的时间范围查询
parameters.name: to_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the log field for group statistics. This parameter is required. Use a field returned by ListProtoLogSupportIndex whose SupportGroupBy is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 分组统计的日志字段名，不能为空。使用 ListProtoLogSupportIndex 返回且 SupportGroupBy 为 true 的字段
parameters.name: log_field

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of groups to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 最多返回的分组数量，取值为 1～100。该参数必须传入
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort the results by log count in ascending order. Valid values:
true: Ascending order.
false: Descending order.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否按日志条数升序排列。true 表示升序；false 或不传表示降序
parameters.name: order_by_count_asc

parameters.help_en: The site for log query. You can obtain valid values from the Sites parameter returned by DescribeDeliveryDestination. In multi-site scenarios, the specified site is used preferentially if it is active. If this parameter is not specified or the specified site is unavailable, the system automatically selects an active site. If only one active site exists, that site is used. If no active site exists, the LogDeliveryNotOpen error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 日志查询站点，可从 DescribeDeliveryDestination 返回的 Sites 中获取。多站点场景下优先使用有效的指定站点；未指定或指定站点不可用时，系统自动选择可用站点。仅有一个可用站点时使用该站点；无可用站点时返回 LogDeliveryNotOpen
parameters.name: site

Data.description_en: The field group statistics results. This parameter may be empty if no matching data is found
Data.description_zh: 字段分组统计结果；无匹配数据时可能为空

LogField.description_en: The field name used for group statistics
LogField.description_zh: 本次分组统计使用的字段名

TopList.description_en: The list of field value groups, sorted in the order specified by OrderByCountAsc. The number of groups does not exceed the value of MaxResults
TopList.description_zh: 字段值分组列表，按 OrderByCountAsc 指定的顺序排列，数量不超过 MaxResults

LogFieldKey.description_en: The field value of the group

ProtoLogCount.description_en: The number of protocol log entries for the field value
ProtoLogCount.description_zh: 该字段值对应的协议日志条数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed. This parameter is empty if the request was successful. The example shows a scenario in which the query range is invalid
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示查询范围无效场景

Message.description_en: The result message of the request. If the request failed, this parameter describes the error cause. The example shows a scenario in which the query range is invalid
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示查询范围无效场景

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
